Tall & 6.5-Foot Specific Jokes: Why did I fail my NBA tryout at six-and-a-half feet? Every time I went up for a rebound, I fell to pieces, and my heart just wasn't in it!
How did I grow to six-and-a-half feet? Lots of milk... though it all went straight to my bones and skipped the rest of me!
What is the hardest part about being a six-and-a-half-foot skeleton? Finding jeans with a 42-inch inseam and a zero-inch waist!
How's the weather up here at six-and-a-half feet? Chilling! There's a serious draft blowing right through my ribs tonight.
Why don't I ever slouch? At my height, I have to show a little backbone!
Music, Food & Everyday Skeleton Life: What is my favorite musical instrument? A trom-bone!
Why am I so bad at playing the piano compared to the trombone? Because I don't have any organs!
What is a skeleton's favorite meal at a barbecue? Spare ribs! Though honestly, I don't have the stomach for them.
How do French skeletons say hello on Halloween? Bone-jour!
Why did I cross the road? To get to the body shop!
What do you call a skeleton who refuses to get out of bed all day? Lazy bones!
Why didn't I go to the scary movie last night? I just didn't have the guts!
Who is the most famous skeleton detective? Sherlock Bones!
How do skeletons send their Halloween party invitations? By tele-bone!
Why are skeletons such terrible liars? Because you can see right through us!
Why didn't I dance at the Halloween party? I had no body to dance with!
What do skeletons say before they start eating their Halloween candy? Bone-appetit!
Why are skeletons always so calm and relaxed? Because nothing ever gets under our skin!
What do you call a skeleton that rings the doorbell and runs away? A dead ringer!
General Kid-Friendly Halloween Jokes: Why didn't the ghost take the elevator to the top floor? Because it only lifts spirits!
What is a mummy's favorite genre of music? Wrap music!
Why are graveyards the noisiest places in town on Halloween? Because of all the coffins!
What do you get when you cross a vampire and a snowman? Frostbite!
How do you fix a broken jack-o'-lantern? With a pumpkin patch!
Why did the vampire read the newspaper every morning? He heard it had great circulation!
